svg.title: System context: factory, adapter, external tools
svg.desc: The factory reaches an external coding harness only through the neutral Harness trait; the dsh adapter is the first implementation, and it reaches dsh and git only through a CommandRunner.

g.text: EXTERNAL PROCESSES · DSH BINARY AND GIT
